740600201.text: Huh? You're... Genevieve, right? What brings you here?

740600202.text: Well I'm here to do some Pankration, but... what are YOU doing here? You aren't hoping to sign up too... are you?

740600203.text: #Ah, I know you two. Sorry, the {M#blond}{F#blonde} one can't participate.

740600205.text: #That was worded a little misleadingly. I think what you mean is that {NICKNAME} specifically is banned from taking part, not blonds as an entire category. Correct?

740600206.text: Because I'm blonde, and... you let me sign up.

740600209.text: Lemme put it this way: A Pankration match is a spectator sport. Entertaining the audience is more important than who wins and who loses.

740600210.text: #I've heard all about your past deeds. If we let {NICKNAME} enter the ring, the outcome is a foregone conclusion, and all the anticipation is removed from the equation.

740600211.text: No one wants to watch a match with a predictable outcome. If I let you take part, I might as well hand you the trophy right now and save everyone the trouble...

740600208.text: Paimon has... Wait, what's the opposite of deja vu? Anyway, Paimon has that. Because the last time we were in a situation like this, both Darcy and Estienne were practically begging us to participate...

740600401.text: How's it going, Poiret? Will he be joining our team?

740600404.text: As much as I enjoy the detective jokes, from what I've seen of your combat capabilities, you're about as good in a fight as a Blubberbeast.

740600405.text: Joining your team would be like debuting on stage just before the curtains close.

740600406.text: If I had time for that, don't you think I'd be better off rehearsing for the Tri-Coupon Troupe's performance?

740600407.text: You make a lot of good points. But I would like to refute one of them.

740600409.text: I may have lost to Roussimoff in unarmed combat, but I've changed my fighting style since then. Now, I can at least draw in a fight with a Sternshield Crab.

740600412.text: What a pity. Such a delicious opponent...

740600416.text: #Might I add that {NICKNAME} has agreed to coach us. I'm sure we stand a much greater chance of winning with help from {M#him}{F#her}.

740600417.text: The best coach can't help a lost cause... But you said you'd changed your fighting style?

740600418.text: Yes. Close-quarter combat is not my forte, so I've prepared numerous bottles... filled with Cryo energy.

740600419.text: With these, I can slow down my opponents in the arena. And also treat them to a delicious ice-cold Fonta outside the ring, to maintain cordial relations.

740600420.text: Paimon's so jealous... Wait, is that how bottles of Cryo are supposed to be used?

740600422.text: ...What? Aren't you a researcher? Where'd you learn to use an axe?

740600423.text: Rest assured that I'm quite handy with an axe. I chop firewood for stress-relief when my research hits a wall.

740600426.text: #I have a suggestion. Why don't we have a little sparring session now? That way, you can show me your skills, and Coach {NICKNAME} can get a sense of your fighting styles. What do you think?

740600427.text: Depending on how the sparring goes... I may or may not decide to join your team.

740600428.text: Hmm... Seems like a reasonable suggestion. What do you think, Poiret?

740600429.text: Yes, excellent suggestion. If only you'd come up with it sooner... I think I've used up all my mental energy on making detective jokes.

740600430.text: Hahaha. Well, I would say let's get right to the Pankration Ring and not waste any more time, but... Are you sure you're dressed for a sparring match?

740600431.text: What do you mean? I always dress like this when I'm chopping firewood...

740600432.text: You should change into something that's easier to move around in. Fortunately, the troupe has some costumes — give me a minute...

740600433.text: Goncourt gets a set of comfortable clothes for Genevieve.

740600434.text: She's your opponent though. Isn't it counter-productive to help her...?

740600435.text: It's not a fair fight if she's handicapped by her clothes.

740600436.text: Thank you, you're very considerate. Whichever way this goes, you have my respect as an opponent.

740600437.text: Haha. Alright, I can officially say it now: Let's get right to the Pankration Ring and not waste any more time! I'm sure Roussimoff won't mind us borrowing it for a while.

740600415.text: Yes. I realize now that it was a reckless decision on my part, so I've decided to avoid unarmed combat from now on.

740600501.text: We'd like to use this place to train with Goncourt.

740600502.text: Sure thing. No problem at all.

740600503.text: #Please observe our fight closely, Coaches {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

740600504.text: Truth be told, Poiret and I lack fighting experience... especially this kind of fighting, so...

740600505.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Please let us know right away if you have any advice during the fight.</color>

740600509.text: Now, let's warm up and get ready to enter the arena.

740600510.text: Goncourt can't be stronger than a Sternshield Crab, right? You can do it!

740600508.text: I trust your judgment. As long as it isn't a fatal mistake, there's always a chance to turn it around, right?

740600702.text: It was close. Could have gone either way!

740600703.text: Ah, I've been waiting sooo long for a chance to say that.

740600704.text: Erm... but it was two against one, so based on Goncourt's pankration ethics, this probably didn't count as a fair fight.

740600705.text: No, no, it absolutely counts. The rules allow it. Plus, I was going easy on you — you're new to this, after all.

740600708.text: What would be the point? I was only testing their skills, why would I want to risk injuring them?

740600709.text: Fair point... Well anyway, since they impressed you, are you willing to join our team now?

740600712.text: #I may have chosen to join if it was just the two of them. But with {NICKNAME} here, I'm somewhat superfluous.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Rag and Bone Shop

740600801.text: The props should be around here... They'll be packed in some flimsy wooden boxes.

740600802.text: If you find them, go ahead and <color=#00E1FFFF>crack them open</color>.

subQuests.subQuestName: Break the wooden boxes and recover the props

740601001.text: What the heck is all this!? Does your troupe really use these in your performances?

740601002.text: Using them is optional, but having them is mandatory. That's my motto!

740601003.text: I know nothing about performing... So I'll take your word for it, Goncourt.

740601004.text: ...Wait, but this is a fight, not a performance... right?

740601005.text: Yes, but it's still for entertainment purposes. The Pankration Ring can be considered a stage of sorts. I look forward to watching you shine on the stage.

740601006.text: With all your preparation so far, I'm sure your first fight will be a breeze. I heard your opponent is a big blue fella, and while he might be a stocky guy, I don't think he's a match for you.

740601008.text: #You're too kind. My assistance has been minimal. I'll leave the hard work to you, {NICKNAME}.

740601011.text: #Coach {NICKNAME}, could you ask Roussimoff when the matches will officially begin? We'll be ready to fight whenever you say the word.

740601012.text: I'll watch your fights if I have the time. Best of luck in the tournament!

740601013.text: Thanks for everything! You're a great guy.

740601014.text: Haha, and thanks to Poiret for the detective jokes. I'm hoping to work some of them into my scripts. If any of you have any good ideas for a story, do let me know.

740601010.text: Our first opponent won't be that difficult, right? So let's use the same system as we did before — just give us any input you think we need during the fight.

740601103.text: Yeah... fast to lose, furious in defeat...

740601104.text: Why are you being so pessimistic!?

740601105.text: Sounds like holding all those Cryo bottles has cooled his enthusiasm, haha!

740601106.text: Huh? So, elemental energy really does have that kind of effect? Of course! The Fontaine Research Institute was right after all. Instead of elemental energy—

740601107.text: ...If you're ready, you can start whenever you like.

740601110.text: Nothing! Just forget I said anything...

740601112.text: Ahem, now then — your first opponent has quite an interesting origin story. He was stuffed into a barrel, and the barrel had a note on it that said: Take a look in the mirror.

740601113.text: Obviously, the person who stuffed him in the barrel is also participating. So if he beats you, it'll be his chance at revenge in the ring.

740601114.text: After all, fighting's prohibited outside the ring — it's his only chance to win a fight and not get punished for it. Of course, he'll still be entitled to visit the infirmary if he loses.

740601115.text: So. Are you ready to enter the ring?

740601301.text: Congratulations to the researcher and research assistant! A first-bout victory for our first-time fighters!

740601302.text: As for the guy in the barrel, don't be discouraged! We'll see you again in the next competition!

740601401.text: Ugh, that Roussimoff... I am NOT a research assistant.

740601402.text: Hey, a research assistant is a very good job. Maybe you should consider it. If nothing else, working at the Fontaine Research Institute would be much better job security than working as a detective's assistant.

740601403.text: Fair enough, I'll give it some thought. If I ever manage to leave this place...

740601404.text: So how did the two of you team up, anyway? You seem like very different personalities, and you don't have much common ground professionally, either.

740601405.text: That's not entirely true. The truth is, I was doing an investigation at the Fontaine Research Institute before I came here. Everything was going fine until I ran into that Melusine...

740601406.text: I was just gathering evidence, but she insisted that it was theft.

740601408.text: Taking private documents from the Fontaine Research Institute, which would generally be considered as constituting theft.

740601409.text: I'll have you know they were problematic documents. Anyway, I pleaded guilty and accepted my punishment.

740601410.text: Sounds like there's an interesting story here...

740601411.text: I'm not at liberty to divulge the details of the case, as it would violate client confidentiality.

740601412.text: I'm all too familiar with the subject of his investigation. I injured them during a conference...

740601413.text: Ma'am, please! Stop! What did I JUST say about divulging details!?

740601414.text: Oh! Sorry. Yeah, it's nothing to do with the competition, anyway, so we shouldn't bore our poor coach with all this.

740601416.text: You want us to violate my client's terms of engagement, and my code of professional ethics, AND pay you for the privilege!?

740601420.text: Alright, let's get back to business. Coach, in your professional opinion, what do we need to improve on?

740601419.text: Heh, you can probably read all about it in The Steambird or some detective novel... Though I can't vouch for the credibility in either case.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Rift of Erosion

740601601.text: This looks like a great place to practice throwing!

740601602.text: Goncourt gave us a bunch of stuff earlier. Some of it should come in handy here...

740601603.text: Genevieve and Poiret set up a practice area...

740601604.text: It's a little jerry-rigged... but it should be fit for purpose. Coach, why don't you give us a demonstration first?

subQuests.subQuestName: Demonstrate throwing techniques to the pair

740601802.text: I understand it in principle, but...

740601804.text: #{NICKNAME}, maybe we should let them have some practice now?

740601807.text: And you need hand-eye coordination. Speaking of which, Poiret has to wear glasses. Will your poor eyesight affect your accuracy?

740601808.text: Oh, these are just a fashion statement. They're not prescription lenses.

740601809.text: Huh? ...That must be a nuisance, surely? Wearing those in the ring?

740601810.text: You just have to treat them as an extension of your body. Besides, if I take them off, no one'll recognize me.

740601806.text: Yep. Muscle memory is the key here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Pankration Ring the next day between 18:00 and 22:00

740601901.text: I wonder who our next opponent will be...

740602002.text: She's gone to get changed. She'll be back before the match starts.

740602003.text: Your opponent is ready. Let me know when you want to start.

740604601.text: How is this possible? A samurai from afar losing to a feeble researcher and her assistant!?

740604602.text: Will the newcomers' luck ever run out? Find out in the next match!

740602301.text: I'm warning you! It's a serious crime to fight outside the ring!

740602302.text: Do you think I care at this point?

740602303.text: You psycho! Do you solve all your problems with brute force? No wonder you had to fake the data when you couldn't get the results you wanted...

740602304.text: I'm the one who should be warning you. Unless you have evidence to back up your claims, that was blatant slander!

740602305.text: Oh, you didn't like that, huh? Hmph, tough cookies!

740602306.text: You should start thinking about how you're gonna apologize to Mr. Bossuet when you get out of here — IF you ever get out of here.

740602307.text: Hah, what am I saying? I should be thanking you. Mr. Bossuet had to step down thanks to your academic dishonesty.

740602308.text: No way can Raimondo handle all of the Fontaine Research Institute's projects on his own. Once I get out of here...

740602309.text: It never ceases to amaze me how some people can fantasize about such a bright future in this fortress where the sun never shines. A true testament to the power of the human imagination.

740602310.text: Who are you? And how exactly is this any of your business?

740602311.text: Who, me? As you can probably guess, I'm just a lowly assistant. A nobody, really.

740602312.text: We're all contestants here, so let's try and be a little cordial to one other outside the ring, shall we? I have a delicious iced health drink here, very sweet. Would you care for a glass?

740602313.text: What? Wait, no... I'm not even a contestant.

740602314.text: Tsk. He didn't fall for it.

740602315.text: Unlike some people, I refuse to stoop to using brute force to prove my own value. A Fontaine Research Institute lab is too good for you. A lumberjack's cabin in the mountains is where you belong...

740602317.text: How dare you! Private brawls are... You all saw that too, right!? Private brawls are prohibited!

740602318.text: Oh, goodness. I'm so sorry — I took my glasses off for a second, and my eyesight is terrible without them. I'm afraid I didn't see a thing.

740602321.text: Oh, great... Is anybody here not a pathological liar? No? Just my luck.

740602324.text: You self-righteous, conniving... Ugh, I'll wipe those smug looks off each of your faces, just you wait! My Vieille-Model Enhanced Meka will prove everything...

740602327.text: I'm sorry you had to see that. I... have a bit of a short fuse. I always try my best to stay rational, objective, and neutral in all scenarios but... sometimes, I fail to control myself.

740602323.text: Are you gonna fight back? No one's stopping you. But I hear it's a serious crime to fight outside the ring.

740602501.text: Okay, Genevieve! So, what's your idea?

740602502.text: So as I was saying, we need to utilize the mutually destructive effects of pneuma and ousia energy to weaken the clockwork meka and create opportunities to attack.

740602503.text: This is far beyond the scope of my abilities. I bid you all adieu.

740602504.text: Don't go! I can't accomplish this without you.

740602505.text: With some processing, pneumousia can be stored in a container — even in your sugar glass bottles.

740602506.text: I'm familiar with the structural weaknesses of clockwork meka. So if you create an opening, I can go in and attack.

740602507.text: Ooh... That might actually work! And Poiret has been practicing his throwing, so hopefully his speed and accuracy should have improved by now.

740602508.text: But I don't know anything about the principle of mutual annihilation between pneuma and ousia...

740602511.text: This isn't a research project, so you don't need to grapple with the theory. All you need to know is which action causes what reaction.

740602512.text: First things first, help me set up a practice arena.

740602513.text: Genevieve and Poiret set up a practice arena...

740602514.text: ...Are these from the stage props Goncourt gave us, too?

subQuests.subQuestName: Demonstrate the destructive power of Pneumousia annihilation reactions to Poiret

740602703.text: Is that a genuine thanks? Or a "Gee, thanks"...?

740602706.text: Anyway — let's meet at the pankration ring before the next match, like last time.

740602707.text: Alright... Don't die on us, Poiret! You need to live on!

740602708.text: Oh, don't be so dramatic! The stage props are getting to your head... But sure, I'll try to avoid getting annihilated along with the pneuma and ousia.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Pankration Ring the next day between 18:00 and 22:00

740602801.text: I know we can win this...

740602901.text: Hey, Poiret. How did the training go? Did it work?

740602902.text: Yep. I'm now fully versed in the mutually destructive properties of pneuma and ousia energy.

740602905.text: Sorry, I was just joking. I still don't really get how it works... But I do know what I have to do.

740602906.text: Good! Because you'll be facing a heavyweight this time, haha!

740602907.text: Well? Ready to enter the arena?

740602908.text: #I'm ready. Don't forget to give us your input during match, {NICKNAME}.

740603101.text: #What an exhilarating match! Congratulations to the researcher and her assistant! And of course to their coach, {NICKNAME}!

740603102.text: But I have some breaking news! Don't get too comfortable, because this match... is entering overtime!

740603103.text: Your spectacular performance really put me in the mood for a brawl. So allow me to be your opponent during the overtime match!

740603301.text: I accept my defeat. Looks really can be deceiving! Haha!

740603302.text: You... never said anything... about an... overtime match... I'm about to... pass out...

740603303.text: No entertainment-driven tournament would be complete without a few exciting plot twists!

740603304.text: Same applies to using firecrackers in the ring! Or sweet-scented sugar glass bottles!

740603305.text: Without further ado, are you ready to receive your prize?

740603307.text: Are we? Hmm... Meh, if we forgot about it, it can't be that important!

740603312.text: Those meka were his pride and joy, and we tore them to shreds. Would you stick around to be humiliated further? He's probably hiding away to escape the shame.

740603313.text: Hmm, I doubt it... Like you said, they were his pride and joy. I don't think he's going to take this lying down...

740603314.text: Ah, you've got nothing to worry about! You're the champions, and you even defeated me! You can handle whatever else he might throw at you.

740603315.text: Be that as it may... Fighting two matches back to back has completely exhausted me. I need to sit down, or I'm gonna faint...

740603316.text: Right now, he could throw a newborn puppy at me and I'd probably lose the fight...

740603317.text: Champvallon returns, and he's brought some "friends"...

740603318.text: My Vieille-Model Enhanced Meka... You destroyed my Vieille-Model Enhanced Meka!

740603320.text: Ugh... Leave him to me. I've still got some fight in me!

740603322.text: I guess it's my time to shine.

740603323.text: #Yeah! Let Coach {NICKNAME} show you how it's done!

740603503.text: You... all that Mora... all those Coupons!

740603506.text: You're completely mad, all of you... No more messing with crazy. I'm done!

740603507.text: Ugh, I should have known after last time... What a spectacular failure this was. I'm admitting defeat, and I'm leaving.

740603508.text: Not without me, you're not! Let's find somewhere to discuss reimbursement for my losses. Just look at the mess you've made of my precious Pankration Ring...

740603509.text: Oh, but first — it gives me great pleasure to present the champions with the grand prize! Be proud of yourselves. You've earned it.

740603511.text: That was pretty underwhelming in the end. Feels like all that preparation was a lot of effort for nothing...

740603512.text: #But it was worth it to see {NICKNAME} in the ring! So cool! Hehe!

740604101.text: Are you ready to watch the match?

740603701.text: You want to use the pankration ring? Go ahead!

740603801.text: Is there enough sugar? What a waste...

740603901.text: Since we're at the pankration ring, I'll go by "Goncourt IV." You can call me "The Fourth."

740604001.text: My axe... I'd better use it carefully.

740604201.text: Come on, Coach. My hands are getting sweaty from the nerves. Less procrastination, more pankration...

740604301.text: Stuffed inside a barrel? How is that possible? I wonder how they did it...

740604401.text: Are you ready to watch the match?

740604701.text: Are you ready to watch the match?

740604801.text: Don't think about what's in the bottle... Just aim and throw, aim and throw...

740605101.text: Pankration Recreational Tournament now underway. Spectators welcome.

740605201.text: Latest Pankration Results: The guy in the barrel was defeated! The researcher and her assistant advance to the next round!

740605203.text: We mustn't overlook the coach's contribution in this match. I suggest crediting them in the results.

740605301.text: #Latest Pankration Results: The samurai from afar lost in a two-against-one battle! The feeble researcher and her assistant stole the limelight thanks to their {M#blond}{F#blonde} coach's training!

740605303.text: Maybe we should consider giving him a consolation prize since he came such a long way?

740605304.text: I would personally present him with an award if he helps promote Fonta in Inazuma.
